title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Charges Raised on a Callout
content:
## The basis on which money is raised against a callout

The member pays the plan's excess toward each Keyturn Roadside Assistance callout, and on the plans
that waive it for a vehicle on a marketplace trip nothing is charged where the trip record shows the vehicle was out with a guest. It
is the trip record, and not the member's account of the day, that settles whether the vehicle was out
with a guest.

Towing beyond the included distance is charged at the plan's overage rate on the miles beyond it, not
on the whole distance, and the included distance is never charged for.

A callout taken once the allowance is used is charged at the plan's additional callout price in place
of the excess rather than on top of it.

A charge raised in error is reversed against the callout it was raised on, and no charge is raised at
all on a callout the operator could not attend.

### The towing charge as a definition of the amount

Where the distance towed is greater than the distance the plan includes, the money charged on the
callout is the plan's excess taken together with the plan's overage rate multiplied by the number of
miles by which the distance towed exceeds the included distance, the whole then rounded to two decimal
places. The rate is multiplied only by those excess miles; the product is then taken together with the
excess; and the rounding is applied once, to the resulting total. Where the distance towed is not
greater than the distance the plan includes, this basis does not arise.

### A worked illustration on hypothetical figures

Take, purely as an illustration and not as any plan's figures, a plan whose excess stands at USD 20.00
and whose overage rate stands at USD 4.00 for each mile beyond an included distance of 30 miles, and a
tow of 47 miles. The distance towed exceeds the included distance by 17 miles. At the overage rate
those 17 miles come to USD 68.00. Taken together with the excess of USD 20.00, the money charged on the
callout is USD 88.00, which is already exact to two decimal places. The 30 included miles are not
charged for, and the rate is not applied to the whole 47.
